privacy.whatAccount: Your account and settings, your playlists, and any devices you have paired.
privacy.whatBody: NicotinD keeps a record of what you listen to, so it can show your stats and stop radio repeating the same songs.
privacy.whatHistory: Your listening history: which track, when, how long you played it, and how it ended.
privacy.whatPrivate: Your listening history is yours. Other users cannot see it, and administrators only see a total count — never what you played.
